sections.name: Two diagrams, two engines, one primitive
sections.summary: A class diagram is structural — it routes to D2 and renders in-process, so it freezes with zero tooling. A gantt is quantitative (its meaning lives in POSITION on a time axis) — it routes to Mermaid. The 'render:' chip on each card names the engine the standard chose. See protocol/diagrams.md for the full best-engine-per-type table.
